title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
abstract: arXiv:2611.28833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier language models can now read and edit the weights of a neural network much like code and thereby improve a small model, an approach known as Weight-Space Programming (WSP). We further explore applying WSP to a language model itself, which we call Self-WSP. Specifically, Qwen3.5-0.8B reads its own weights, proposes an edit, and then continues with the edited weights as both problem solver and editor. We find many cases of genuine self-improvement. Self-edits can raise GSM8K accuracy from 11.8% to 62.2% and MATH500 accuracy from 7.0% to 32.2%, sometimes by changing only 16 parameters, and in some cases repeated self-editing keeps improving the model. A closer look, however, reveals that these gains lack interpretability. The model shows little understanding of the edits it makes, and WSP driven by random search sometimes performs comparably. translated_title: Self-WSP：语言模型能否通过权重空间编程实现自我提升？
translated_abstract: 前沿语言模型如今可以像阅读和编辑代码一样读取和编辑神经网络的权重，从而改进一个小模型，这种方法被称为权重空间编程。我们进一步探索将WSP应用于语言模型自身，并将其称为Self-WSP。具体而言，Qwen3.5-0.8B读取自身的权重，提出一次编辑，然后以编辑后的权重继续同时担任问题求解者和编辑者的角色。我们发现了许多真正的自我提升案例：自我编辑可以将GSM8K准确率从11.8%提升至62.2%，将MATH500准确率从7.0%提升至32.2%，有时仅需修改16个参数；在某些情况下，重复的自我编辑能够持续改进模型。然而，深入分析表明，这些提升缺乏可解释性——模型对自身所做的编辑几乎没有理解，而且由随机搜索驱动的WSP有时也能取得相当的表现。因此，Self-WSP作为通往递归自我改进（RSI）的一条路径具有前景，但要真正实现这一目标仍面临挑战。
tldr: 该论文提出Self-WSP方法，让Qwen3.5-0.8B语言模型读取并编辑自身权重从而实现自我提升，可将数学推理准确率大幅提高（如GSM8K从11.8%升至62.2%），但这些改进缺乏可解释性，且随机搜索有时也能达到类似效果，表明其作为递归自我改进路径前景与挑战并存。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Self-WSP, where a language model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) reads and edits its own weights to achieve genuine self-improvement with large accuracy gains (e.g., GSM8K from 11.8% to 62.2%), though these gains lack interpretability and random search sometimes performs comparably, highlighting both promise and challenges toward recursive self-improvement.
